## About
Japanese Auto Care is a family owned and operated shop on Sandalfoot Plaza Dr in Boca Raton. Our ASE Certified technicians handle car and truck repair and the manufacturer's recommended maintenance to OE (original equipment) specifications or higher, and we get you back on the road quickly.
Neighbors know Jimmy and his team. One reviewer said we explain everything clearly without any high-pressure sales tactics. Another said they have trusted us with their cars for years and feel grateful to have found a place they can trust.
We hold a 4.7 rating from 224 Google reviews, and we'd be glad to earn your trust too.

## Services
- Free Transmission Check: A free performance check with a fluid check, road test, pan examination and lift inspection to see how your transmission is doing.
- Transmission Repair Service: Repair and service for automatic and standard transmissions and clutches.
- Check Engine Light: Free check engine light readings, plus full engine diagnostics and repair.
- Oil Changes: Full service premium lube and oil change with a 15-point vehicle safety inspection.
- Air Conditioning: Complete air conditioning and heating system service.
- Timing Belts & Water Pumps Repair: Timing belt and water pump replacement. One reviewer had a timing belt and thermostat replaced on a Honda Accord here.
- Exhaust, Muffler and Gasket Repair: We diagnose and repair your exhaust system, including exhaust manifolds and catalytic converters.
- Shocks, Struts and Suspension Work: Shock and strut replacement and suspension repair for cars and trucks.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Do you charge to read my check engine light?
A: No. We do free check engine light readings, along with full engine diagnostics and repair.

Q: Can you tow my car?
A: Yes. We offer towing and emergency services anywhere in South Florida.

Q: How soon can you get me in?
A: Call us and we'll do our best. One reviewer was brought in the same day for a transmission fluid replacement.
